sources.title: Short-form video is shifting toward useful entertainment
sources.detail: Audiences reward practical tips packaged with a strong point of view.
sources.suggested_response: Film a 20-second swing fix with one surprising test and a booking CTA.

sources.title: Proof-led creative is outperforming polished claims
sources.detail: Show the before/after, not just the promise.
sources.suggested_response: Turn a launch-monitor result into a split-screen before/after reel.

sources.title: Major-week conversations are spiking around pressure golf
sources.detail: Players, routines and clutch decisions are the conversation hooks.
sources.suggested_response: Post a pressure-game challenge: closest to the pin under a timer.

sources.title: Launch-monitor data remains a mainstream golf story
sources.detail: Golfers want understandable numbers, not a wall of metrics.
sources.suggested_response: Create a 'one number that changed the shot' carousel from a fitting.

sources.title: TrackMan is leaning harder into measurable improvement
sources.detail: Competitor messaging makes data feel accessible and actionable.
sources.suggested_response: Own the local proof: publish one customer outcome with permission.

sources.title: Foresight keeps selling indoor realism and playability
sources.detail: The category is moving beyond practice into repeatable entertainment.
sources.suggested_response: Position Swing Shack as the social round that happens to improve your game.

sources.title: Toptracer makes group competition the product
sources.detail: Simple leaderboards give casual golfers a reason to return.
